tunde.name: Tunde
tunde.greeting: Morning! A small parcel needs taking to Bisi. Pick it up at the parcel stand first.
tunde.help: Start a delivery here, collect the parcel, then find Bisi beside the kiosk.

amara.name: Amara
amara.greeting: Welcome. There is rice and stew today. Eat well before your next shift.
amara.help: Buy food at my stall, then press I to eat from your bag.

sade.name: Sade
sade.greeting: Hello, neighbour. Water and a quick snack?
sade.help: Small purchases help your needs. Check your cash before buying.

bisi.name: Bisi
bisi.greeting: Good to see you. I am sketching ideas for the courtyard garden.
bisi.help: The room is west of the food stall. Sleep there to start a fresh day.

femi.name: Femi
femi.greeting: I need someone careful with the stock. Match each requested item to its shelf.
femi.help: Finish a delivery first, then try a stock shift. A wrong match ends the shift without pay.
